changeSet.createView: select u.id, u.version, u.display_name, (select e.address from who_credential_identity ci join who_email_credential e on e.id = ci.credential_id where ci.identity_id = u.id order by e.id limit 1) as email, (select r.name from who_identity_role ir join who_role r on r.id = ir.role_id where ir.identity_id = u.id order by r.name limit 1) as role, case when i.status = 'ACTIVE' then 'ACTIVE' else 'DEACTIVATED' end as status, i.created_at as joined_at, not exists (select 1 from who_session s where s.identity_id = u.id) as invited from roux_user u join who_identity i on i.id = u.id

changeSet.author: roux
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO who_role_permission (role_id, permission) SELECT r.id, p.permission FROM who_role r CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('users.read'), ('users.invite'), ('users.manage')) AS p(permission) WHERE r.name = 'OWNER' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
